versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei·小红书热门关键词 skill.

- Enables structured XHS (小红书) public content data retrieval: keyword search, note detail lookup, comment fetching, creator/author posts extraction.
- Supports use cases such as trending discovery, competitor analysis, KOL monitoring, comment sentiment analysis.
- Returns data as JSON for easy integration and further processing.
- CLI usage examples and parameter details included for search, detail, comment, and post monitoring.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access; guidance and error handling for input and usage included.
- Designed for data retrieval only—not for login, publishing, or private content access.
